title: LNXA20WKF, Wakefield Library  ADA Renovation
agency_path: City of New York > Design and Construction
description_text: The Department of Design and Construction is seeking a Special Inspector to provide special inspection services for the LNXA20WKF - Wakefield Library  ADA Renovation - Special Inspections project. This Project consists of adding an accessible ramp and plaza to the front entry, exterior lighting, making the vestibule and entry doors accessible, upgrading the first-floor toilet room to be accessible and making the cellar ramp accessible. A new sidewalk will be constructed at the front side of library for better accessibility. Please see RFI Form, project specific agreement, and bidset drawings for more information.
